version_metadata.description:
FloraFinder AI is your intelligent botanical companion, powered by on-device Apple Intelligence and deep plant pathology AI.

Key Features:
• Instant On-Device Identification: Point your camera at any plant, flower, tree, or leaf to identify taxonomy, genus, and binomial nomenclature with zero cloud latency and complete offline privacy.
• Plant Doctor & Pathology Rx: Diagnose plant diseases, leaf spots, nutrient deficiencies, and pest infestations. Get actionable immediate, organic, and chemical recovery regimens.
• Complete Horticultural Care Guides: Master sunlight requirements, watering cycles, soil composition, and pet toxicity alerts for dogs and cats.
• Private & Secure: On-device neural vision processing keeps your photos private on your device.
version_metadata.promotional_text: Instant on-device plant identification, pet toxicity safety alerts, and deep AI disease diagnostics.

app_review_information.review_notes: FloraFinder AI uses on-device Apple Vision for real-time plant and flower identification, with cloud AI for disease pathology diagnosis. No login or demo account is required to access full functionality.
